rules.statistics: median needs 3 admitted records, else missing; min and max are shown from 1 admitted; outlier = absolute relative deviation from the set median strictly above 0.5, flag only; deviations in exact 38-digit half-even decimals, given to 4 dp in records[].deviation_4dp
rules.selection: auto: public comps with >= 3 admitted, else precedents with >= 3 admitted, else Insufficient Information (known text, multiple missing); explicit bases never fall back; blend = plain average of both medians, both needed; blend is never automatic; selected multiple = chosen value rounded half-even to 2 dp
rules.rounding_of_display: deploy_vii/display.py: ROUND_HALF_UP on the exact value, thousands commas; MILLIONS amounts at decimals 1, multiples at decimals 2, counts as '<n> records' (no singular)
rules.t1c10_rows: public_comps for auto, public_comps and blend (or when peer records exist); precedents for precedents and blend (or when precedent records exist); issuer_trading and user_multiple rows for those bases (single value: min = median = max = the value, outliers not_applicable, n_total 1)
rules.t1c9_none_row: when the context has no peer or precedent records T1C.9 holds one row `none` (all cells not_applicable; for peer_source cp_dr_public with a peer basis or auto, missing with the Design 8 text); user_list names give rows e01.. with name known and every figure cell missing
rules.citations: a fact from the user's field cites {source_id context, locator line:N, quote the stripped line}; N is the line of the field in the context file's json.dumps(indent=2) text (ensure_ascii False, LF, trailing LF); the citation's source_sha256 is contexts.<case>.sha256 in the manifest
rules.value_classes: user figures and names: source; Python-composed text and the labels: normalized; multiples, statistics, selection, EBITDA and implied EV: calculated (user_multiple's selected_multiple: source); calculation_id is `calc:<fact_id>` on calculated facts
rules.t1c_1_to_8: unchanged: equal to the frozen cp1c-owner no_peers case (positive for credit-plus-comps); the analyst submission does not change
rules.limitation_order: the frozen case's own_limitations, then own_limitations_new in order (a new line equal to a frozen line is not repeated), then on a synthetic run the synthetic line
rules.cp4c: every valuation case (v01-v03, the stress case included) carries the selected multiple M when known; a submitted multiple equal to M numerically is accepted (7 equals 7.00); another value or `not assessed` is refused with `valuation <case_id>: multiple <submitted as typed> differs from the CP-1C selected multiple <M at 2 dp>`, one issue per valuation in case order; EV = CP-2G FY2026 EBITDA x M exact; implied LTM multiple = EV / 30; the T4E.3 multiple cell's formula gains the suffix; when M is unknown CP-4C applies no multiple rule; when the context pins ev_multiple the pin governs (Ruled Q4)
